_comment: Front-emblem grammar for the cap2 family. Every bound is derived from the base's own pixels, not chosen.

zone.name: front_panel
zone.derivation: the flat field of a single authored value (step 1, RGB 81) that the author's own emblem sits inside
zone.note: row 10 alone widens to cols 7-12, but the safe rectangle common to all three rows is 4x3. A motif may not rely on the wider middle row.
zone.why_small: this is the whole flat area the authored construction provides. It is not a limitation we chose and must not be enlarged by editing the cap.

placement.anchor: centred horizontally in the 4-wide zone; a 3-wide motif sits at x8-10 by integer division
placement.vertical: centred in the 3-row zone; a 1-row motif sits on row 10, exactly where the author put theirs
placement.repositioning: FORBIDDEN — the authored cells are the placement

size_bounds.note: a motif larger than 4x3 would cross the visor edge or the crown seam

denied_motif_categories: bands and trims (no band zone exists on this construction)
feathers, poms, tassels, bows (attachments; nothing may project outside the authored silhouette)
gemstones or jewellery (reserved for a future fantasy/festival tag)
anything needing its own outline colour outside the base vocabulary

occupancy.why: the zone is 4x3; two motifs would touch and read as noise

readability.rule: solid runs, high contrast. Alternating single pixels fragment into noise at gameplay scale.
readability.contrast_floor: a motif must differ from the field (step 1, luminance 81) by at least 80 luminance; step 3 is 165 (+84) and step 5 is 254 (+173)
readability.palette_roles: motifs are drawn in the base's OWN vocabulary steps so they recolour with the garment. They are cloth, not metal, and never carry an independent hue.
readability.judged_at: 4x gameplay scale, worn, not on a transparency checker

direction_behaviour.Front: the emblem is drawn here and only here
direction_behaviour.Right: EMPTY — the front panel is not visible in profile on this construction
direction_behaviour.Back: EMPTY — no front panel exists behind
direction_behaviour.per_view_adaptation: not required and not permitted; the author draws front-only and no compressed side variant exists to derive from
direction_behaviour.why_sides_stay_empty: inventing a side or back emblem would be procedural invention, which this family forbids

palette_role_constraints.why: multiplicative tinting scales the whole authored ladder by the tint's luminance, so every rung shrinks proportionally. Source span 197 became 102-117 across the four palettes; predicted and measured agreed to within 1.
palette_role_constraints.weakest_rung: visor field to outline is only 24 apart in the source — the author relied on the sprite being drawn near-white. Tinting halved it to 13, at which point the visor's field merged with its own outline and the peak changed apparent thickness.
palette_role_constraints.remedy: darken the OUTLINE role only, until it separates. Geometry is provably identical across variants, hue is untouched, and the crown/visor relationship is untouched.
palette_role_constraints.not_a_geometry_change: the base, visor and silhouette are not modified
